Every entry MUST declare a ctx (the nearest structural ancestor of the finding). Without one an entry silences a whole route, which is how the first version of this file accidentally hid nearly every tap finding on /articles/.

accepted.reason: Shiki github-light token colour #e36209 measures 3.49:1 on 14px code text. The colour is theme DATA supplied by the highlighter, not our CSS, so fixing it means choosing a different Shiki theme — a design decision about how code reads, not a bug fix.
accepted.removeWhen: the highlighting theme is replaced with an AA-safe pair

accepted.reason: Links that are the entire content of a prose table cell render 18px tall. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 exempts links inside a sentence or block of text; a table cell containing only a link is arguably not one, so this is a genuine judgement call rather than a clear pass or fail. Fixing it means restyling markdown tables site-wide.
accepted.removeWhen: prose table cells give their links a 24px target
